scope.summary: Implement text variables as resolvable placeholders whose single edit updates every instance. The variable set is enumerable and normative: Chapter Number (with before/after text + numbering style), Creation Date, Modification Date, Output Date (of current print/export/package), Custom Text (reusable placeholder), File Name (include-path + include-extension options), Image Name / Metadata Caption (metadata pulled from a nearby placed image driving live captions), Last Page Number (section or document, for page-x-of-y — shared with MT-151), Running Header (first/last on-page styled text — shared with MT-151), Document Fields (author + other metadata + user-defined custom variables). Resolved at composition; participates in book synchronization (MT-172).
acceptance_criteria: full enumerated text-variable set resolves at composition; single edit updates all instances
expected_tests: live: editing a variable updates every instance at composition

risk_if_missed: No live placeholders; captions, dates, and file-name fields require manual maintenance.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
